title: fraud-synth-bench: Reproducible fraud-analytics research on synthetic data
description:
A seeded synthetic transaction generator with pluggable fraud scenarios, drift schedules and label delay, plus a pre-registered comparison of classic and modern fraud-detection models under extreme imbalance, concept drift, ring fraud, label delay and investigator capacity limits. Every number in the accompanying paper is rebuilt by make reproduce.

All data is synthetic; no real transactions are used.
